147:89 (Load more) IS BUILT BUT NOT MEASURED HERE, and the reason is the
board rather than the code: 147:87 and 147:89 are drawn stacked, and in the
product they are mutually exclusive — `Loading 8 more…` renders while
`isLoading`, `Load more` renders while it is not. No single screen can show
both, so a recipe pinned to one state can only anchor one of them, and the
loading row is the one no click can reach. The 36-high row it now sits in
is the board's (147:89) and is anchored `stock-load-more-row` for whoever
boards the idle state.
